message.content: The archivist is considering whether to sign off on the map backup involving snapshot M3. The backup job log (S3) confirms snapshot M3 was created at 23:05, supporting claim A with high confidence. However, claim B is contradicted by the storage receipt (S2), which shows snapshot M3 stored on volume East, not West. Claim C remains unresolved because although the final parcel boundary layer was marked ready before 23:05 (S1), there is no direct evidence confirming its inclusion in snapshot M3. Given the uncertainty about the critical final layer’s presence in the backup, the archivist should weigh this unresolved claim carefully before approving the backup.
